inputs.text: The war in Iran keeps dragging on as a brutal demonstration of how militaristic policies built on historical power imbalances and institutional biases keep exploiting the most vulnerable groups. Energy prices are spiking and slamming working families along with the poorest communities hardest, with flights grounded and our feeds flooded with nonstop death and destruction. Bloomberg is highlighting the global outcry demanding an end to this poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's endangering well-being for everyone. Yet the public in Israel stays firmly behind pushing it forward with no clear end in sight. This stark divide shows how such aggressions sacrifice marginalized populations worldwide while shielding the privileged from the full human and economic costs, and it's long past time for structural reforms to protect those who always pay the price first.

subtopics: Rising energy prices and impacts on working families and poor communities
Public support in Israel for continuing the conflict
